Deviload 2.6.7 adds Devil Music and improves cookies setup and media search.

- Explore the YouTube Music catalog, search for songs and open albums and playlists in **Devil Music**. Guest playback depends on YouTube availability; some tracks or networks may be restricted.
- Open the large **Now Playing** view, reorder the queue, remove and restore queued tracks, or choose **Play next**. Download MP3 directly from song cards, the queue or the player without stopping the music or replacing your unfinished download form.
- Recommendations adapt to likes, listening and early skips. Choose familiar music or more discoveries, and exclude songs or artists from recommendations.
- Preferences stay on this computer without an account. Use **Music profile → Export / Import** to back them up before reinstalling or transfer them to another computer. Profiles are bounded to 2 MB and contain no media files or account credentials.
- Control playback from the Windows taskbar thumbnail or the tray menu.
- Playback retries preserve the listening position and use a fresh source after failure. Interrupted audio transfers have a bounded retry; unavailable tracks and service rate limits do not trigger endless attempts.
- Reduce duplicate audio requests during seeking, space out stream resolution, and share the cooldown when YouTube rate-limits audio. Retry a temporarily rejected fresh stream once before requesting a replacement.
- Fix intermittent Windows playback disconnects when audio requests arrive in separate packets. Retry temporary stream-format failures once and keep unavailable tracks out of retry loops.
- Prepare the next queued song and upcoming recommendations during the last 45 seconds of steady playback to reduce the pause between tracks, including shuffle. Manual selections can cancel background extraction; background failures leave the current song playing, with bounded preparation requests.

- Add **Apply cookies** in Settings → Accounts. Check a cookies.txt file before saving it, report invalid or expired files, and remember its path after restarting without having to start a download first.
- Show which cookies source downloads use. A valid file does not guarantee that a website still accepts the session; access is checked when downloading.
- Add **Load more** to YouTube and YouTube Music search. Keep existing results when loading another page, skip duplicates and allow retrying failed searches. Search now uses the saved cookies source and stops stalled requests after one minute.
- Adjust AppImage rendering for compatibility with Linux graphics drivers. Run window actions asynchronously and extend the Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 AppImage smoke test to three minutes.
- Update Russian and Spanish translations for the new controls and messages.

Your download history, library and settings stay in place.

Accept the update prompt in Deviload on Windows, macOS or AppImage. For the Windows portable build or Debian package, download the matching file from this release. The macOS test build remains unsigned by Apple.

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.6...v2.6.7
